title: Remove Nth Node From End
contract: Delete the nth node from the end of a nonempty list, where 1 ≤ n ≤ length; return remaining values.
brute: Node dummy=new Node(0);dummy.next=list(input);int size=input.length;Node previous=dummy;for(int i=0;i<size-n;i++)previous=previous.next;emit("Locate predecessor using the length","removed",previous.next.value);previous.next=previous.next.next;return values(dummy.next);
optimal: Node dummy=new Node(0);dummy.next=list(input);Node fast=dummy,slow=dummy;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)fast=fast.next;while(fast.next!=null){fast=fast.next;slow=slow.next;emit("Maintain an n-node gap","slow",slow.value,"fast",fast.value);}slow.next=slow.next.next;return values(dummy.next);
reasoning: Use the known length to locate the predecessor of the deletion position.
Start two pointers at a dummy node and advance fast n steps before moving both.
Stop when fast is the last node; slow then precedes the target. The dummy handles removal of the head without a separate branch. Both are linear; the gap method works without a precomputed length.
